Name: Ilucie's Trinket replacements
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Replaces the Parrot Trinket with a cute Birb or with an Owl and the Fairy Trinket with a Fairy Shrimp.

The Fairy Shrimp comes in 6 different colors - Orange (default), Blue, Chrome, Mantis, Rosa and Yellow.

You can toggle the mod on and off in the Mod Config menu or in the config-file itself.
You can also chose the Shrimp colors there. Pick one color and deactivate the other ones :).


This mod is compatible with other mods, that replace the trinkets because it only replaces the individual sprites.
(if another mod replaces the whole asset-file, it might overwrite them)



The Birb sprite itself is from one of the random ingame birds, the Owl is also a vanilla Sprite (but I changed the colors).
The Shrimp is obviously a mix between the Shrimp and the Fairy.


[b]I love Shrimps.[/b]
